# shumoku_topology_source (Resource)

Attaches a `shumoku_data_source` to a `shumoku_topology`, as a topology source or a metrics source. Requires an `admin` API token. A data source can be attached to a topology once per purpose. Detaching a topology-purpose source also deletes the observations it contributed.

Import with `<topology_id>/<attachment_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shumoku_topology_source" "campus_zabbix" {
  topology_id    = shumoku_topology.campus.id
  data_source_id = shumoku_data_source.zabbix.id
  purpose        = "topology"
  sync_mode      = "on_view"
}

resource "shumoku_topology_source" "campus_metrics" {
  topology_id    = shumoku_topology.campus.id
  data_source_id = shumoku_data_source.zabbix.id
  purpose        = "metrics"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_source_id` (String) Data source id. Changing it forces a new attachment.
- `purpose` (String) `topology` (the source contributes nodes and links) or `metrics` (it feeds metrics). Changing it forces a new attachment.
- `topology_id` (String) Topology id. Changing it forces a new attachment.

### Optional

- `link_contribution` (String) How the source's links contribute: `add` or `update`. Defaults to `add`.
- `node_contribution` (String) How the source's nodes contribute: `scoop` (add them) or `anchor` (only enrich nodes other sources have). Defaults to `scoop`.
- `options_json` (String) Plugin-specific sync options as a JSON string (use `jsonencode`); see the plugin's `optionsSchema` in `shumoku_data_source_types`. Compared semantically.
- `priority` (Number) Ordering among the topology's sources (lower first). Defaults to `0`.
- `sync_mode` (String) When the source is synced: `manual`, `on_view` or `webhook`. Defaults to `manual`. `webhook` makes the server generate `webhook_secret`; leaving `webhook` clears it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Creation time, Unix milliseconds.
- `id` (String) Server-generated attachment id (not the data source id).
- `webhook_secret` (String, Sensitive) Server-generated webhook secret when `sync_mode` is `webhook`, otherwise empty.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An attachment is imported as <topology_id>/<attachment_id>. The attachment id
# is the "id" field in GET /api/topologies/<topology_id>/sources.
terraform import shumoku_topology_source.campus_zabbix <topology_id>/<attachment_id>
```
